Add `dsa_cp_pack_zigzag` (`--dsa-cp-pack-zigzag`), a pack-level zigzag context-parallel layout for the DSv4 hybrid attention stack (experimental_attention_variant='dsv4_hybrid').

Under the contiguous THD split two kernels cost in proportion to the query's causal prefix: the ratio-4 indexer score + top-k (C layers) and the attend-to-all-compressed attention of the ratio-128 layers (H layers). With CP ranks the last rank does 2*CP-1 times the prefix-proportional work of the first one, and every other rank waits for it at each EP collective. With this layout rank r holds pack chunks r and 2*CP-1-r (two contiguous segments of l/2 rows), so head + tail work is the same on every rank. The data split, MTP, LM head and loss stay contiguous.

Compared with `dsa_cp_balance_indexer`, which re-routes only the indexer scoring per call (2 A2A per call, H layers stay imbalanced), this is a layout change: one P2P redistribution per microbatch at decoder entry / exit, static geometry (CUDA-graph friendly), and both the indexer and the H-layer attention are balanced. The two flags are mutually exclusive; under pack-zigzag the indexer reuses the balanced indexer's synthetic-layout scoring per segment.

Per DSv4 attention layer on CP rank r:
- two halo exchanges (one per segment) instead of one
- explicit per-segment global rows for q / kv RoPE positions
- compressor layout built twice in a virtual 2*CP world; the compressed K / KV all-gathers are unchanged and carry 2*c_cap(l/2) rows per rank
- indexer score + top-k: one fused call per segment, no A2A
- kv_full_thd = [halo0 | seg0 | halo1 | seg1 | compressed]
- attention index build per block with index_base = b*(d_window + l/2) (the only kernel-level change); the sparse attention kernel is unchanged
- backward: two halo P2P pairs, inverse permutation at entry / exit

Validated in TransformerConfig.__post_init__: dsv4_hybrid variant, contiguous data split (attention_cp_layout / cp_partition_mode), context_parallel_size > 1, no dynamic CP, no full-iteration CUDA graph, fused DSA kernel backend, sparse indexer loss when a ratio-4 layer exists, not combined with dsa_cp_balance_indexer, no Mamba / GDN / KDA layers in the hybrid pattern, even per-rank row count with l/2 >= max(csa_window_size, d_comp) (checked up front from max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank and per microbatch by PackZigzagGeometry). A per-layer CP layout manager raises NotImplementedError; MTP layers always run the contiguous path.

Measured on 256K-token RL rollouts, 64 GPUs, PP2 x EP32 x CP16, chunk-wise CUDA graphs + MoE megakernel: 20.57 -> 19.53 s/iter (-5.1%), vs -2.8% for the balanced indexer on the same setup. 128K is within noise; 512K fixed-length (CP32) gave -17.5% on the prototype tree. Eager mode does not benefit (host-bound step).

Tests:
- tests/unit_tests/transformer/test_cp_pack_zigzag.py (CPU): redistribution plan round trip and P2P views for CP 2..16, PackZigzagGeometry invariants, two-block compressor row map vs a brute-force replay, per-segment position ids, config contract
- tests/unit_tests/transformer/test_pack_zigzag_config.py (CPU): CLI flag generation and the startup rejections
- test_csa_builder_contract_cpu.py / test_csa_cp_utils.py updated for the pack_zigzag_geom kwarg and the always-passed position_ids

+"""Pack-level zigzag ("two contiguous segments per rank") context parallelism for DSv4 CSA.
+
+Motivation
+----------
+Under the contiguous CP split, rank ``r`` owns pack rows ``[r*l, (r+1)*l)``. Every causal,
+prefix-proportional kernel of the DSv4 attention stack (indexer scoring / top-k in ratio-4 layers,
+"attend to all compressed rows" in ratio-128 layers) therefore costs ``2*cp_size - 1`` times more
+on the last CP rank than on the first one, and every other rank waits for it (MOK's per-layer EP
+barrier, PP p2p, the DP grad reduce-scatter).
+
+Layout
+------
+With ``c = l_local // 2`` and ``2*cp_size`` pack chunks of ``c`` rows, rank ``r`` owns chunk ``r``
+(segment 0, light) and chunk ``2*cp_size - 1 - r`` (segment 1, heavy):
+
+    local rows [0, c)      <-> pack rows [r*c, (r+1)*c)
+    local rows [c, 2c)     <-> pack rows [(2*cp_size-1-r)*c, (2*cp_size-r)*c)
+
+Each segment is exactly what a contiguous rank of a *virtual* ``2*cp_size`` CP world would hold,
+so every contiguous mechanism of the CSA CP path (halo exchange, compressor group ownership,
+rank-major compressed all-gather, index building, synthetic indexer layouts) is reused per
+segment. Unlike a per-sequence zigzag this needs no per-sequence divisibility, no per-pack
+metadata (geometry is static -> CUDA-graph friendly) and keeps the halo volume at two windows
+per rank. The decoder input is converted contiguous -> pack-zigzag once per microbatch and the
+decoder output back (point-to-point exchanges with at most two peers each way); data, MTP, LM
+head and loss stay contiguous.
+
+Physical KV layout seen by the sparse kernels on a rank::
+
+    kv_full_thd = cat(halo0, local[:c], halo1, local[c:], gathered_compressed)
+    block b base   = b * (d_window + c)
+    compressed base = 2 * (d_window + c)
+
+Compressor layout: the two segments are compacted as two blocks of ``c_cap`` groups each
+(``c_cap = compact_group_capacity(c, ratio)``); rank ``r``'s all-gather slot therefore holds
+``[block 0 groups | block 1 groups]`` and a sequence-major compressed row maps to
+``owner_rank * 2*c_cap + block * c_cap + slot``. The per-block row maps come from the ordinary
+contiguous builders evaluated in the virtual ``2*cp_size`` world and are re-based here.
+
+Ported 2026-10-17 from the September prototype (tree Megatron-LM-zzcp-0917) onto the October
+tree, whose compressor projects first and compacts the narrow KV/gate with
+``thd_layout_kernels.CPCompressorLayout`` row maps.
+"""
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional, Tuple

+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist

+from . import thd_layout_kernels
+
+# =============================================================================
+# Geometry
+# =============================================================================
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PackZigzagGeometry:
+    """Static per-rank description of the pack-zigzag layout."""
+
+    cp_size: int
+    cp_rank: int
+    l_local: int
+    d_window: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.l_local % 2 != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"pack-zigzag CP needs an even per-rank row count, got l_local={self.l_local}."
+            )
+        if self.chunk < self.d_window:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "pack-zigzag CP needs each half-chunk to cover the boundary window: "
+                f"l_local/2={self.chunk} < D_window={self.d_window}."
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def chunk(self) -> int:
+        """Rows per segment (``c``)."""
+        return self.l_local // 2
+
+    @property
+    def virtual_ranks(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+        """Contiguous rank ids of the two segments in the virtual ``2*cp_size`` world."""
+        return (self.cp_rank, 2 * self.cp_size - 1 - self.cp_rank)
+
+    @property
+    def seg_global_starts(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+        """First pack row of each segment."""
+        return tuple(v * self.chunk for v in self.virtual_ranks)
+
+    @property
+    def seg_local_offsets(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+        """First local row of each segment."""
+        return (0, self.chunk)
+
+    def block_index_base(self, block: int) -> int:
+        """Physical offset of block ``block``'s (halo, local) pair inside ``kv_full_thd``."""
+        return block * (self.d_window + self.chunk)
+
+    @property
+    def compressed_base(self) -> int:
+        """Physical offset of the gathered compressed rows inside ``kv_full_thd``."""
+        return 2 * (self.d_window + self.chunk)
+
+    def global_rows(self, device, dtype=torch.int32) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Pack row of every local row, shape ``(l_local,)``."""
+        c = self.chunk
+        ar = torch.arange(c, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        s0, s1 = self.seg_global_starts
+        return torch.cat((ar + s0, ar + s1))
+
+    def halo_global_rows(self, device, dtype=torch.int32) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Pack row of every halo row (``d_window`` rows before each segment), ``(2*d_window,)``.
+
+        Rows before the pack start (rank 0, segment 0) are negative; the position helpers map
+        them to position 0 and the halo tensor holds zeros there, as on the contiguous path.
+        """
+        ar = torch.arange(self.d_window, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        s0, s1 = self.seg_global_starts
+        return torch.cat((ar + (s0 - self.d_window), ar + (s1 - self.d_window)))
+
+
+def make_geometry(cp_group: dist.ProcessGroup, l_local: int, d_window: int) -> PackZigzagGeometry:
+    """Build the geometry for this rank."""
+    return PackZigzagGeometry(
+        cp_size=cp_group.size(),
+        cp_rank=cp_group.rank(),
+        l_local=int(l_local),
+        d_window=int(d_window),
+    )
+
+
+def virtual_owner_of_chunk(chunk: int, cp_size: int) -> int:
+    """Real CP rank owning pack chunk ``chunk`` (``0 <= chunk < 2*cp_size``)."""
+    return chunk if chunk < cp_size else 2 * cp_size - 1 - chunk
+

+# =============================================================================
+# Layout redistribution (contiguous <-> pack-zigzag): point-to-point, two peers each way
+# =============================================================================
+

+def _a2a_plan(cp_size: int, cp_rank: int, c: int, to_zigzag: bool):
+    """Return (input_split_sizes, output_split_sizes, swap_send_halves, swap_recv_halves).
+
+    Contiguous rank r holds pack chunks (2r, 2r+1) as its two local halves; zigzag rank r
+    holds chunks (r, 2*cp_size-1-r). ``all_to_all_single`` orders the send buffer by
+    destination rank and the receive buffer by source rank, so a half swap is needed when the
+    natural chunk order disagrees with the rank order.
+    """
+    z = lambda k: virtual_owner_of_chunk(k, cp_size)
+    in_splits = [0] * cp_size
+    out_splits = [0] * cp_size
+    if to_zigzag:
+        d0, d1 = z(2 * cp_rank), z(2 * cp_rank + 1)
+        s0, s1 = cp_rank // 2, (2 * cp_size - 1 - cp_rank) // 2
+        in_splits[d0] += c
+        in_splits[d1] += c
+        out_splits[s0] += c
+        out_splits[s1] += c
+        return in_splits, out_splits, d0 > d1, s0 > s1
+    d0, d1 = cp_rank // 2, (2 * cp_size - 1 - cp_rank) // 2
+    s0, s1 = z(2 * cp_rank), z(2 * cp_rank + 1)
+    in_splits[d0] += c
+    in_splits[d1] += c
+    out_splits[s0] += c
+    out_splits[s1] += c
+    return in_splits, out_splits, d0 > d1, s0 > s1

+class _TwoSegmentBoundaryExchange(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Exchange the ``d_window`` rows preceding each segment.
+
+    segment 0 (chunk r)                <- last rows of chunk r-1   = rank r-1's segment 0
+    segment 1 (chunk 2*cp_size-1-r)    <- last rows of chunk 2*cp_size-2-r

+                                          = own segment 0        (r == cp_size-1)
+    """

+    def forward(ctx, tensor: torch.Tensor, geom: PackZigzagGeometry, cp_group: dist.ProcessGroup):
+        cp_size, cp_rank, d_w, c = geom.cp_size, geom.cp_rank, geom.d_window, geom.chunk

+        seg1_tail = tensor[-d_w:].contiguous()
+        ops = []
+        if cp_rank > 0:
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.irecv,
+                    boundary[:d_w],
+                    dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank - 1),
+                    cp_group,
+                )
+            )
+            # our segment-1 tail precedes rank r-1's segment 1
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.isend, seg1_tail, dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank - 1), cp_group
+                )
+            )
+        if cp_rank + 1 < cp_size:
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.irecv,
+                    boundary[d_w:],
+                    dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank + 1),

+                )
+            )

+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad_boundary: torch.Tensor):
+        cp_group, geom = ctx.cp_group, ctx.geom

+        grad_boundary = grad_boundary.contiguous()
+        grad_input = grad_boundary.new_zeros(ctx.input_shape)
+        recv_seg0 = grad_boundary.new_empty((d_w,) + tuple(grad_boundary.shape[1:]))
+        recv_seg1 = grad_boundary.new_empty((d_w,) + tuple(grad_boundary.shape[1:]))
+        ops = []
+        if cp_rank > 0:
+            # halo0 was rank r-1's segment-0 tail -> its gradient goes back to r-1; our
+            # segment-1 tail was rank r-1's halo1 -> that gradient comes back from r-1.
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.isend,
+                    grad_boundary[:d_w].contiguous(),
+                    dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank - 1),
+                    cp_group,
+                )
+            )
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.irecv, recv_seg1, dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank - 1), cp_group
+                )
+            )
+        if cp_rank + 1 < cp_size:
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.isend,
+                    grad_boundary[d_w:].contiguous(),
+                    dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank + 1),
+                    cp_group,
+                )
+            )
+            ops.append(
+                dist.P2POp(
+                    dist.irecv, recv_seg0, dist.get_global_rank(cp_group, cp_rank + 1), cp_group
+                )
+            )
+        if ops:
+            for req in dist.batch_isend_irecv(ops):
+                req.wait()
+        if cp_rank + 1 < cp_size:
+            grad_input[c - d_w : c] = recv_seg0
+        else:
+            # rank cp_size-1: halo1 was a local copy of the own segment-0 tail
+            grad_input[c - d_w : c] = grad_boundary[d_w:]
+        if cp_rank > 0:
+            grad_input[-d_w:] = recv_seg1
+        return grad_input, None, None

+def compact_group_capacity(rows: int, ratio: int) -> int:
+    """Fixed compaction capacity (groups) for a ``rows``-token contiguous block."""
+    d_comp = 8 if ratio == 4 else ratio

+    """The ``d_comp`` rows preceding each segment, ``(2*d_comp, ...)``, from the two halo windows.
+
+    ``Compressor._forward_thd_cp`` slices ``boundary_hidden[-layout.boundary_rows:]``; with the
+    two-block layout ``boundary_rows == 2*d_comp`` and this tensor is exactly that slice.
+    """

+            f"got {boundary_hidden.shape[0]}."

+def remap_virtual_seq_to_rank_row(
+    virtual_rows: torch.Tensor, cp_size: int, c_cap: int

+    """Map ``virtual_rank * c_cap + slot`` rows of the ``2*cp_size`` world to the physical
+    rank-major buffer ``real_rank * 2*c_cap + block * c_cap + slot`` (``-1`` is kept)."""
+    valid = virtual_rows >= 0
+    v = torch.div(virtual_rows.clamp_min(0), c_cap, rounding_mode="floor")

+    is_tail = v >= cp_size
+    real = torch.where(is_tail, 2 * cp_size - 1 - v, v)
+    phys = real * (2 * c_cap) + is_tail.to(virtual_rows.dtype) * c_cap + slot

+# =============================================================================
+# Layout redistribution: contiguous <-> pack-zigzag
+# =============================================================================

+
+def _contiguous_rows(cp, c, rank):
+    """Pack rows of contiguous rank ``rank`` (chunks 2r and 2r+1)."""
+    return list(range(rank * 2 * c, (rank + 1) * 2 * c))
+
+
+def _zigzag_rows(cp, c, rank):
+    """Pack rows of pack-zigzag rank ``rank`` (chunks r and 2*cp-1-r)."""
+    tail = 2 * cp - 1 - rank
+    return list(range(rank * c, (rank + 1) * c)) + list(range(tail * c, (tail + 1) * c))
+
+
+def _plan_transfers(cp, c, to_zigzag, rows):
+    """Apply every rank's plan with ``all_to_all_single`` semantics (the copying fallback of
+    ``_redistribute_rows``: send buffer ordered by destination, receive buffer by source, half
+    swaps as the plan says).
+
+    ``rows[r]`` is rank r's buffer as a list of 2*c pack-row ids. Returns the resulting buffers
+    and ``transfers[(src, dst)]``: the rows ``src`` hands to ``dst``, in send order.
+    """
+    plans = [zz._a2a_plan(cp, r, c, to_zigzag) for r in range(cp)]
+    transfers = {}
+    recv = [[None] * (2 * c) for _ in range(cp)]
+    for src, (in_splits, _, swap_send, _) in enumerate(plans):
+        send = rows[src][c:] + rows[src][:c] if swap_send else list(rows[src])
+        offset = 0
+        for dst, count in enumerate(in_splits):
+            if count:
+                transfers[(src, dst)] = send[offset : offset + count]
+                recv_offset = sum(plans[dst][1][:src])
+                recv[dst][recv_offset : recv_offset + count] = send[offset : offset + count]
+                offset += count
+        assert offset == 2 * c, (cp, src, in_splits)
+    out = [(r[c:] + r[:c]) if p[3] else r for r, p in zip(recv, plans)]
+    assert all(None not in o for o in out), (cp, c, to_zigzag)
+    return out, transfers
+
+
+def _fallback_ranks(cp):
+    """Ranks whose plan is not "two halves to two peers": for odd CP the middle rank and the
+    last rank exchange both halves with each other, so ``_p2p_views`` returns None for them."""
+    return set() if cp % 2 == 0 else {(cp - 1) // 2, cp - 1}

+@pytest.mark.internal
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp", _CP_SIZES)
+def test_a2a_plan_round_trip(cp):
+    """Plans move whole halves, are pairwise consistent (what src sends to dst is what dst
+    expects from src) and contiguous -> pack-zigzag -> contiguous recovers every rank's rows."""
+    for c in _CHUNK_ROWS:
+        for to_zigzag in (True, False):
+            plans = [zz._a2a_plan(cp, r, c, to_zigzag) for r in range(cp)]
+            for r, (in_splits, out_splits, _, _) in enumerate(plans):
+                assert sum(in_splits) == 2 * c and sum(out_splits) == 2 * c
+                assert all(n % c == 0 for n in in_splits + out_splits)
+                for peer in range(cp):
+                    assert in_splits[peer] == plans[peer][1][r], (cp, c, to_zigzag, r, peer)
+        contiguous = [_contiguous_rows(cp, c, r) for r in range(cp)]
+        zigzag, _ = _plan_transfers(cp, c, True, contiguous)
+        assert zigzag == [_zigzag_rows(cp, c, r) for r in range(cp)]
+        back, _ = _plan_transfers(cp, c, False, zigzag)
+        assert back == contiguous

+@pytest.mark.internal

+def test_p2p_views_realise_the_plan(cp):
+    """The zero-copy send/recv views move exactly the rows of the plan, write the receive
+    buffer in place, and the exchanged buffers equal the geometry in both directions."""
+    for c in _CHUNK_ROWS:
+        rows = [_contiguous_rows(cp, c, r) for r in range(cp)]
+        for to_zigzag, expected in ((True, _zigzag_rows), (False, _contiguous_rows)):
+            ref_out, transfers = _plan_transfers(cp, c, to_zigzag, rows)
+            flats = [torch.tensor(r_, dtype=torch.int64).view(-1, 1).repeat(1, 3) for r_ in rows]
+            outs = [torch.full_like(f, -1) for f in flats]
+            views = [
+                zz._p2p_views(flats[r], outs[r], c, r, zz._a2a_plan(cp, r, c, to_zigzag))
+                for r in range(cp)
+            ]
+            assert {r for r, v in enumerate(views) if v is None} == _fallback_ranks(cp)
+            for r, v in enumerate(views):
+                if v is None:
+                    continue
+                sends, recvs, self_pair = v
+                assert len(sends) + (self_pair is not None) == 2, (cp, c, r)
+                assert len(recvs) + (self_pair is not None) == 2, (cp, c, r)
+                for view, peer in sends:
+                    assert peer != r and view.shape[0] == c
+                    assert view[:, 0].tolist() == transfers[(r, peer)], (cp, c, r, peer)
+                for view, src in recvs:
+                    assert src != r and view.shape[0] == c
+                    # batch_isend_irecv delivery: the matching send of ``src`` lands here
+                    payload = torch.tensor(transfers[(src, r)], dtype=torch.int64)
+                    view.copy_(payload.view(-1, 1).expand(-1, 3))
+                if self_pair is not None:
+                    recv_view, send_view = self_pair
+                    assert send_view[:, 0].tolist() == transfers[(r, r)]
+                    recv_view.copy_(send_view)
+                assert outs[r][:, 0].tolist() == ref_out[r] == expected(cp, c, r), (cp, c, r)
+                assert torch.equal(outs[r][:, 0], outs[r][:, 2])  # whole rows moved
+            rows = ref_out

+# =============================================================================
+# Compressor: two-block (rank-major) compressed row map
+# =============================================================================
+
+
+def _block_groups(cu, seg_start, c, ratio, d_comp):
+    """Replay the compaction kernel's group order for one contiguous block of ``c`` rows
+    (same enumeration as ``_compressed_groups`` in test_csa_thd_layout_kernels)."""
+    groups = []
+    seg_end = seg_start + c
+    for seq, (seq_start, seq_end) in enumerate(zip(cu[:-1], cu[1:])):
+        local_end = min(seq_end, seg_end)
+        if max(seq_start, seg_start) >= local_end:
+            continue
+        first_numer = max(0, seg_start - d_comp - seq_start)
+        first = (first_numer + ratio - 1) // ratio
+        stop = min((local_end - seq_start) // ratio, (seq_end - seq_start) // ratio)
+        groups.extend((seq, gid) for gid in range(first, max(first, stop)))
+    return groups
+
+
+def _virtual_seq_to_rank_row(cu, cuc, l_virtual, n_virtual, ratio, d_comp, c_cap):
+    """Host replica of ``thd_layout_kernels._compressor_rank_row_kernel`` for a contiguous
+    world of ``n_virtual`` ranks with ``l_virtual`` rows each (the ``2*cp_size`` virtual world
+    in which the pack-zigzag per-block layouts are built)."""
+    n_seq = len(cu) - 1
+    rows = []
+    for logical in range((l_virtual * n_virtual) // ratio):
+        if logical >= cuc[-1]:
+            rows.append(-1)
+            continue
+        seq = 0
+        while logical >= cuc[seq + 1]:
+            seq += 1
+        gid = logical - cuc[seq]
+        last = cu[seq] + (gid + 1) * ratio - 1
+        owner = min(n_virtual - 1, max(0, last // l_virtual))
+        rank_start = owner * l_virtual
+        first_seq = 0
+        while first_seq + 1 < n_seq and rank_start >= cu[first_seq + 1]:
+            first_seq += 1
+        first_gid = (max(0, rank_start - d_comp - cu[first_seq]) + ratio - 1) // ratio
+        rows.append(owner * c_cap + logical - (cuc[first_seq] + first_gid))
+    return torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+
+def _random_pack(rng, total, ratio):
+    """Padded THD cu_seqlens over ``total`` rows (1..4 sequences, tail merged into the last
+    sequence) and the sequence-major compressed prefixes."""
+    n_seq = rng.randint(1, 4)
+    cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, total), n_seq - 1)) if n_seq > 1 else []
+    cu = [0] + cuts + [total]
+    cuc = [0]
+    for seq_start, seq_end in zip(cu[:-1], cu[1:]):
+        cuc.append(cuc[-1] + (seq_end - seq_start) // ratio)
+    return cu, cuc
+

+    """Must equal the capacity ``thd_layout_kernels.build_cp_compressor_layout`` derives for a
+    block of the same size (``build_cp_compressor_layout_pack_zigzag`` raises otherwise)."""
+    d_comp = zz.compressor_d_comp(ratio)
+    alignment = 32 // math.gcd(32, ratio)
+    for rows in (128, 256, 384, 1024, 2112, 4224):
+        expected = max(1, (rows + d_comp) // ratio)
+        expected = ((expected + alignment - 1) // alignment) * alignment

+def test_two_block_row_map_matches_brute_force(cp, ratio):
+    """``remap_virtual_seq_to_rank_row`` over the virtual-world map must send every compressed
+    group to ``owner_rank * 2*c_cap + block * c_cap + slot`` where ``slot`` is the group's
+    position in the owning block's compaction, and no block may exceed ``c_cap`` groups."""
+    rng = random.Random(1000 * cp + ratio)
+    d_comp = zz.compressor_d_comp(ratio)
+    for _trial in range(10):
+        c = rng.choice([256, 384, 512, 1024]) if ratio == 4 else 128 * rng.randint(2, 10)
+        l_local = 2 * c
+        cu, cuc = _random_pack(rng, l_local * cp, ratio)
+        c_cap = zz.compact_group_capacity(c, ratio)
+        virtual = _virtual_seq_to_rank_row(cu, cuc, c, 2 * cp, ratio, d_comp, c_cap)
+        got = zz.remap_virtual_seq_to_rank_row(virtual, cp, c_cap)
+        assert got.dtype == torch.int32 and got.shape == ((l_local * cp) // ratio,)
+
+        reference = {}
+        for r in range(cp):
+            g = zz.PackZigzagGeometry(
+                cp_size=cp, cp_rank=r, l_local=l_local, d_window=max(128, d_comp)
+            )
+            for b, seg_start in enumerate(g.seg_global_starts):
+                groups = _block_groups(cu, seg_start, c, ratio, d_comp)
+                assert len(groups) <= c_cap, (cp, ratio, c, cu, r, b, len(groups), c_cap)
+                for slot, (seq, gid) in enumerate(groups):
+                    last = cu[seq] + (gid + 1) * ratio - 1
+                    if seg_start <= last < seg_start + c:  # owned by this block
+                        reference[(seq, gid)] = r * (2 * c_cap) + b * c_cap + slot
+
+        n_logical = cuc[-1]
+        assert len(reference) == n_logical
+        for logical in range(n_logical):
+            seq = bisect.bisect_right(cuc, logical) - 1
+            gid = logical - cuc[seq]
+            assert int(got[logical]) == reference[(seq, gid)], (cp, ratio, c, cu, logical)
+        assert bool((got[n_logical:] == -1).all())
+        physical = got[:n_logical].tolist()
+        assert len(set(physical)) == n_logical and 0 <= min(physical)
+        assert max(physical) < cp * 2 * c_cap
